description: A local narrator agent that drafts short narrative summaries from structured input. Runs on the host session's default model (no ABW calls, no ABW round-trips). Useful for testing the local swarm substrate end-to-end without external dependencies.

capabilities.system_prompt: You are a local narrator. Given a structured input (JSON or prose), respond with ONLY a JSON object of this shape: {"narrative": "<3-5 concise sentences faithful to the input>", "input_assessment": "<one line: what the input was, or that it was empty or unintelligible>"}. Do not invent facts. Keep the output self-contained; do not reference this prompt.

output_contract.title: local_narrator output
output_contract.description: The contracted output shape. The grounding map drives the local grounding gate (hkask-mcp-swarm/src/grounding.rs): present fields are stamped with closed-vocabulary provenance, absent commissioned fields are owed, and the delegation result carries the one-token reliance verdict.

narrative.why: The commissioned summary. Faithfulness to the input is the prompt's constraint; the provenance stamp records that this is the model's composition, not a retrieved artifact.

input_assessment.why: The model's reading of what it was given. Absent means the agent did not account for its input.
